title: Scripture and Wisdom
definition: Scripture and wisdom belong together because God's Word teaches His people to fear the Lord, discern truth, and walk faithfully in daily life.
summary: Scripture gives wisdom for life under the fear of the Lord.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the wisdom of God, and Scripture leads believers to walk wisely in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical wisdom is not cleverness detached from God. It begins with the fear of the Lord and grows through receiving God's Word.

Scripture gives wisdom for decisions, speech, relationships, suffering, money, work, conflict, and worship. It teaches believers how to live faithfully in the real world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often have access to information without possessing wisdom. Scripture and wisdom matters because God's people need discernment shaped by truth, not merely advice.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek wisdom in Scripture before leaning on instinct or cultural opinion. Ask what path honors Christ, loves others, resists sin, and reflects the fear of the Lord.
